summary: Final acceptance passes for the immutable HEAD 4aea1282. AC1 to AC9 hold, and each one maps to a test, a run record, or an independent check on this HEAD. The 20 audio test files pass (231 tests, 4 documented skips). The project gate passes (3389 tests, 9 documented skips). Doctor, the generator check, the live Rune Match budget run, and the 14 hand-off checksums pass. Phase 6 (T9) is deferred by decision. The checker counts it as deferred, but the closeout check needs one plan-line edit (FA-1). Fourteen nonblocking findings carry record work, two test gaps, and the open items to closeout and the PM. HEAD moved to dda92e79 during the audit through two commits of another track (FA-5).
nonblocking_findings: FA-1 [Major] final-acceptance: The T9 line (plan.md:841) fails the closeout check. `plan_closeout_feedback` reports `deferred closeout task lacks done SHA`, because Phase 6 is the last phase block. The final-acceptance counter and `status` count T9 as deferred, because both test the substring `deferred` in the task text. Before closeout, add a SHA to the T9 line, for example `deferral recorded in 03bdf3e5`, the commit that recorded the deferral and AC7. Keep the marker `[ ]` and the word deferred. Do not mark T9 `[x]`. Do not change it to `[b]`: the checker and the Forge doctor ignore `[b]`, and the doctor then fails an in_progress track with no unchecked task. Spec AC7 also requires `[ ]`. Owner: build session, in a plan-only commit.

FA-2 [Major] final-acceptance: The plan lost the completed T6i line. Commit `b88cb45d` deleted `- [x] T6i Green (1b7312f4): own-property guard for event names (adversarial F3)`. `metadata.json` still names T6i as the cause of the fourth round, and `measure/runs/audio_game_integration_20261014/green-p3-t6i.log` says Green flipped the line to `[x]`. Restore the line between T6h and T6j. Owner: build session, in a plan-only commit.

FA-3 [Major] final-acceptance: Four late findings carry the disposition tech-debt and have no row in `measure/tech-debt.md`. They are A5-F4 and A5-F6 (plan.md:831-832) and A6-F2 and ADV5-S1 (plan.md:492-493). Phase 5 acceptance asked to carry A5-F4 and A5-F6 (PA-N1). Add A5-F4 and A5-F6 to TD-48.
